in-ied-2026-state-primary-senate.title: Indiana Election Results: May 5, 2026 Primary Election, State Senator (certified)
in-ied-2026-state-primary-senate.note: From the Division's election results site (https://enr.indianavoters.in.gov/site/index.html), marked certified; version 20260921_104402. 25 districts, 88 candidates. Names as on the ballot, party, votes and winner marks; every candidate's county votes reconciled to the district total. The results carry no write-in line, so a field's total is the sum of its candidates' votes. A field is a party primary with two candidates or more.

in-ied-2026-state-primary-house.title: Indiana Election Results: May 5, 2026 Primary Election, State Representative (certified)
in-ied-2026-state-primary-house.note: From the Division's election results site (https://enr.indianavoters.in.gov/site/index.html), marked certified; version 20260921_104402. 100 districts, 216 candidates. Names as on the ballot, party, votes and winner marks; every candidate's county votes reconciled to the district total. The results carry no write-in line, so a field's total is the sum of its candidates' votes. A field is a party primary with two candidates or more. The county codes (Census FIPS) listed under each district are the race's county_ids.
